response.overview: In the hills of Northeast India, in the heart of Karbi Anglong,a rare handloom weaving tradition has been passed down through generations,carrying the identity, history, and spirit of the Karbi people.But as modernization reshapes lifestyles and fashion,this remarkable craft is slowly disappearing.This documentary follows the journey of a traditional weaver whose struggle reflects that of an entire community determined to keep its heritage alive.From the small village of Donkamokam to the red carpet of Cannes,the film traces how a handmade fabric, once on the verge of being forgotten,became a symbol of culture, pride, and hope.More than a story about weaving, this is a story about identity, resilience, and the enduring bond between people and their traditions. It reminds us that if we do not respect our own culture, we cannot expect the world to respect it. Every handwoven cloth carries a story—but every story needs someone to wear it.
response.title: Red Carpet
